quote: We had six months of agent demos and nothing in production. The thing that changed was checkpointing — once a run could survive a bad tool call, we could actually put one in front of customers.
name: Mara Vane

quote: The trace is the product. When an agent does something strange at 2am, I can replay the exact run instead of guessing from logs.
name: Theo Adeyemi

quote: Typed tools caught more bugs in a week than our eval suite caught in a quarter. The model simply cannot pass an argument that does not compile.
name: Priya Raman

quote: We moved off a homegrown loop in an afternoon. That is the whole review.
name: Jonas Meyer
